user.title: Connect CasaNotify TV
user.description: Use APK 2.0.1 or later and enable the receiver. Enter only the TV IPv4 address, without https:// or a port. Keep discovery port 8765; the panel and commands use HTTPS on 8766. A browser account is not required to pair Home Assistant.

pair.title: Pair {name}
pair.description:
TV {name} at {host}. Open Profile → Panel security on the TV and compare its SHA-256 with the value below. Only confirm if they match. Generate a code in Pair Home Assistant on the TV, or use the key in Show Home Assistant key. Do not enter a browser password, authenticator code or phone pairing code.

SHA-256: {fingerprint}

data.confirm_fingerprint: I compared the certificate on the TV and it matches

error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address without a URL or port.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the receiver and network.
error.unsupported_device: Check the TV IP and update CasaNotify TV to 2.0.1 or later. The device did not return a valid identity.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid code/key or changed certificate. Verify the certificate and generate a new TV code.
error.choose_credential: Enter either a six-digit code OR the API key.
error.confirm_fingerprint: Compare and confirm the certificate on the TV before continuing.

abort.wrong_device: The device identity changed. Check the TV and IP address.
